narrative.details:
Auberdine is a humble place, champion. You will not hear its name spoken in the boughs of Darnassus. Most reference only what the Sundering took from us--the thriving cities of Ameth'Aran, Bashal'Aran, and... Lathar'Lazal.

Yet Auberdine remains in their shadow.

I would see our work here recognized. A new vessel connects us to the kingdom of Stormwind, bringing life and supplies to our shores. I beseech you join its next voyage, and bring this letter to a human called Baros Alexston.

Make our home known.
narrative.objectives: Bring Thundris' Letter to Baros Alexston in Stormwind.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Baros opens the letter and begins to read it, his smile fading.>
narrative.requestItemsText: I can smell the sea on you, friend!<Baros laughs.>What brings you to Stormwind?
